decisions.quote: Considering the pattern exhibited in Figure 1 and the reported effect sizes, we believe our results replicated those of Chum et al. very closely.
decisions.reason: Although the main effect of pointing instructions and the pointing-by-array-size interaction did not reach statistical significance, the authors state an explicit overall verdict concluding that their results replicated those of Chum et al. (2007) very closely. Under Rule 1, the authors' overall verdict on the replication as a whole governs and maps to 'successful'.
